visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and a baby in a front-facing backpack carrier walk along a city sidewalk. The man holds his phone in a selfie position, smiling and speaking. The baby wears a white patterned bib and looks around curiously. In the background, green trees and several parked white and grey cars line the street under bright, overcast daylight. (2) Inside a hair salon with large mirrors and grey walls, the man and the baby are both wrapped in a large, bright yellow haircutting cape. A hairdresser's hand, wearing a black mesh sleeve and a small red smiley face tattoo on the wrist, appears with a green comb and silver electric clippers. The man films their reflection in the mirror using a gold-colored smartphone. (3) On a wooden countertop in front of the mirror, a clear plastic jar filled with various colorful plastic insect toys and a waving red 'Maneki-neko' cat figurine are used as distractions. The baby holds a plastic grasshopper toy while the hairdresser carefully trims the hair on the side of the baby's head. The man continues to smile and look at the phone screen. (4) The baby's facial expression shifts to distress, with eyes squinted and mouth open in a cry. A black hairdryer is brought close to the baby's head by the hairdresser. The man holds the baby closer through the yellow cape, attempting to comfort him while maintaining the selfie angle. (5) In a domestic indoor setting, the baby is seen standing in a white wooden crib. A woman with short dark hair, wearing a white layered dress and a yellow strap, enters through a glass sliding door. She smiles broadly and gestures excitedly with her hands, pointing at the baby's new short haircut as the baby looks at her.
